statement: A response to a USPTO trademark office action (nonfinal or final) is due within three months from the date it issues, with one optional three-month extension available for a fee; applications under Madrid Protocol Section 66(a) have six months to respond and no extension option.
caveat: The office action itself states the controlling deadline — read it; the extension must be requested before the initial three months lapse, post-registration and pre-2022 contexts differ, and a missed deadline abandons the application. This repo does not calculate or extend the deadline.
reviewer: Lane editorial review (situations 2026-10-01); independent domain expert review pending
